title: Sanierung Dorfstrasse - Pilgerstrasse mit Werkleitungen und Bachdurchlässen
description:
Das Projekt umfasst die Sanierung der Dorfstrasse und der Pilgerstrasse. In diesem Zusammenhang werden im Projektperimeter die Wasserleitung ersetzt sowie ein neues Elektrotrassee erstellt.

Ausserdem werden die Bachmauern entlang der Strasse instandgesetzt und die Mauerkrone erhöht.

Weiterer Bestandteil der Arbeiten sind lokale Lokale Instandsetzungen von Brückenplatten bzw. Durchlässen sowie der Ersatz von Brückenplatten.

description: Die Krankenkassen (ob HEK und/ oder hkk am jeweiligen Los teilnehmen, ergibt sich aus der Bezeichnung des jeweiligen Loses) verfolgen das Ziel, mit allen geeigneten pharmazeutischen Unternehmern Rabattverträge nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V über die im jeweiligen Los genannten Wirkstoffe, Wirkstoffkombinationen bzw. Darreichungsformen, Wirkstärken oder Fertigarzneimittel zu schließen. Vertragsgegenständliche Arzneimittel sind - soweit der Vertrag keine Ausnahmen regelt - immer alle austauschbaren Fertigarzneimittel des Vertragspartners nach dem Rahmenvertrag über die Arzneimittelversorgung gemäß § 129 Abs. 2 SGB V. Der Vertragsschluss erfolgt im Rahmen des Open-House-Verfahrens: Individuelle Verhandlungen über Vertragsinhalte werden nicht geführt, es gelten einheitliche Konditionen. Die Krankenkassen sichern einzelnen Vertragspartnern keine Exklusivität zu. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt grundsätzlich maximal 24 Monate beginnend frühestens mit dem 01.02.2025 (ggf. abweichende Startzeiten ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los). Der Vertrag endet spätestens am 31.01.2027 (evtl. Ausnahmen ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los), unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses. Ein Beitritt zu diesem Open-House-Verfahren ist innerhalb der Vertragslaufzeit jederzeit möglich. Alle weiteren Informationen sind den Teilnahme- und Vertragsunterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Senior Procurement Executive Message to the Department of State Contractor and Financial Assistance Community on the Lapse in Appropriations
description: Senior Procurement Executive Message to the Department of State Contractor and Financial Assistance Community on the Lapse in Appropriations As the Department�s Senior Procurement Executive, I am reaching out to share guidance due to the lapse in appropriations that occurred on January 31, 2026. This guidance relates to the handling of Department contract and federal assistance (grants) awards that is consistent with Department and Office of Management and Budget�s Guidance on Operations During a Lapse in Appropriations. The Antideficiency Act prohibits agencies from incurring obligations that are in advance of, or that exceed, an appropriation, with certain limited exceptions. As you are aware, a full fiscal year 2026 appropriation is not yet enacted for the Department of State. For many Department accounts, this results in a lapse in funds designated to purchase certain supplies and services and issue grants and reduces the Department�s capacity to provide oversight on contracts and grants. As a result, certain planned procurements and grants may be cancelled, or postponed, and certain existing contracts and grants may be stopped, suspended, reduced in scope, or terminated. Additionally, payments may be delayed. If the lapse directly affects a contract or grant, on or about January 31, 2026, the Department�s contracting officers and grant officers will notify contractors and grantees of the status of their contract or grant. If a contract or grant will not be affected at the onset of the lapse in appropriations, the Department does not plan to provide any separate notifications or communications of that fact. Unless the contracting officer or grants officer provides a formal notification to the contrary, all Department contractors and grantees must continue to comply with all terms, conditions, requirements and deliveries specified in their contracts or grants. Once an extension to the Continuing Resolution or full-year appropriation is signed into law, the Department will begin implementing the plan to orderly resume activity and will notify contractors at that time. Thank you for your continued partnership with the Department, and for your cooperation as we work together to manage this lapse in appropriations.

title: Residential Apartment Condition Inspection and Reporting Services � U.S. Embassy Singapore
description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Singapore intends to release the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it becomes available. The U.S. Embassy Singapore intends to issue a Request for Quotations (RFQ) for independent residential apartment condition inspection and reporting services at Embassy-leased residential properties in Singapore. The Government anticipates awarding an Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract under which services will be ordered through individual task orders on an as-needed basis. Services are anticipated to include comprehensive visual and functional inspections of residential apartments following landlord rectification and renovation works; identification and documentation of defects and deficiencies; high-resolution photographic records; and preparation of detailed condition reports. The Embassy manages approximately 120 residential apartments, generally ranging from 1,200 to 3,600 square feet. This portfolio size does not represent a guaranteed quantity of inspections. The anticipated contract performance period is one year, with no option periods. The Government may award the contract based on the initial quotation without conducting discussions. Contractors shall comply with the System for Award Management (SAM) registration requirements applicable to this acquisition, as specified in the solicitation and FAR 52.204-7. Contractors shall obtain all licenses, permits, registrations, and authorizations required to perform work in Singapore in accordance with DOSAR 652.242-73, Authorization and Performance. Offerors are advised that contract performance in Singapore may subject the contractor and/or its subcontractors to applicable Singapore laws and regulations, including business registration, employment, labor, and tax requirements. The U.S. Government will not assist contractors in obtaining local approvals or resolving host country compliance matters. Offerors are encouraged to independently assess all local legal, regulatory, and tax obligations prior to submitting a quotation. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered by the agency.

description: INTRODUCTION Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (BEA) Management & Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is seeking an Expression of Interest (EOI) from qualified vendors to provide replacement services for the Air Handling Unit (AHU) at TAN-677. BACKGROUND The TAN-677 facility requires replacement of an aging AHU to improve reliability, energy efficiency, and operational safety. Construction work at the laboratory Site covered under the Davis-Bacon Act is additionally subject to the INL Site Stabilization Agreement (SSA). These Site areas include all areas within the 890-square mile boundary, including the Material and Fuels Complex, Central Facilities Area, Advanced Test Reactor, Radioactive Waste Management Complex, and Specific Manufacturing Capability. The agreement is between signatory contractors and labor unions performing such work. Information regarding the INL Site Stabilization Agreement is available from the Site Labor Coordinator at (208) 524-4404 or at lance@sitelabor.org. Construction work performed at Idaho Falls facilities is not subject to these agreements. PROCESS This EOI is the first step in identifying interested and qualified vendors. title: Lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet palveluineen 2021-2025 (DPS)
description: Lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet palveluineen 2021-2025 (DPS) Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (jäljempänä myös "DPS") kohteena on lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet, sekä niihin liittyvien palveluiden toimittaminen Hansel Oy:n (jäljempänä Hansel) asiakkaille. DPS:n kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä 1 "DPS:n kohde". DPS:n kohteena ovat lukitusjärjestelmät ja -laitteet, sekä niihin liittyvien palveluiden toimittaminen. DPS:llä voi hankkia seuraavia tuotteita: • Elektromekaaniset lukitusjärjestelmät; • Mekaaniset lukitusjärjestelmät; • Lukituskomponentit; • Edellä mainittuihin lukitusjärjestelmiin ja laitteisiin kiinteästi liittyvät ja niiden käyttötarkoitusta palvelevat lisälaitteet ja -tarvikkeet. DPS:n kohteena olevat tuotteisiin liittyvät palvelut ovat seuraavat: • Konsultointi- ja suunnittelupalvelu; • Asennuspalvelut; • Dokumentointipalvelut; • Takuuhuolto; • Korjaushuoltopalvelu; • Ennakkohuoltopalvelu; • Käyttökoulutus ja lisäkoulutus; • Elektromekaanisen lukitusjärjestelmän pääkäyttäjäpalvelut; ja • Avainten säilytyspalvelu ja avainten hallintapalvelu. DPS:n keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. DPS on voimassa 31.1.2027 saakka, ellei sitä keskeytetä aikaisemmin. Hansel Oy:n asiakkaat toteuttavat hankinnat DPS:ään hyväksyttyjen ehdokkaiden kesken DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen 1.2.2021, ellei perustamisvaiheen pidennyksestä muuta johdu, ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä 31.1.2027. Hanselilla on oikeus keskeyttää dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä kesken sen voimassaolon. Hankintasopimukset tulee tehdä ennen dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän päättymistä. Hankintasopimukset voivat olla voimassa enintään 31.1.2027 saakka. Hankintasopimukseen perustuvia hankintoja (tilauksia) voidaan tehdä ennen hankintasopimuksen päättymistä. Tilauksiin perustuvat toimitukset tulee toimittaa viimeistään kuuden (6) kuukauden kuluessa hankintasopimuksen päättymisestä. Hankintasopimus voi kuitenkin olla voimassa enintään 31.1.2035 saakka siltä osin kuin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteena oleviin tuotteisiin hankitaan tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteena olevia palveluita, kuten lukitusjärjestelmän korjaushuoltopalveluita tai ennakkohuoltopalveluita. Tässä kohdassa tarkoitettujen palveluiden tuottamisesta tulee tehdä hankintasopimus ennen dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän päättymistä. DPS:N LAAJUUS Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on enintään 20 500 000 euroa (ilman arvonlisäveroa). Luku on sitoumukseton arvio.,

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Open-House-Rabattverträge 2024-14
description: Die Krankenkassen (ob HEK und/ oder hkk am jeweiligen Los teilnehmen, ergibt sich aus der Bezeichnung des jeweiligen Loses) verfolgen das Ziel, mit allen geeigneten pharmazeutischen Unternehmern Rabattverträge nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V über die im jeweiligen Los genannten Wirkstoffe, Wirkstoffkombinationen bzw. Darreichungsformen, Wirkstärken oder Fertigarzneimittel zu schließen. Vertragsgegenständliche Arzneimittel sind - soweit der Vertrag keine Ausnahmen regelt - immer alle austauschbaren Fertigarzneimittel des Vertragspartners nach dem Rahmenvertrag über die Arzneimittelversorgung gemäß § 129 Abs. 2 SGB V. Der Vertragsschluss erfolgt im Rahmen des Open-House-Verfahrens: Individuelle Verhandlungen über Vertragsinhalte werden nicht geführt, es gelten einheitliche Konditionen. Die Krankenkassen sichern einzelnen Vertragspartnern keine Exklusivität zu. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt grundsätzlich maximal 24 Monate beginnend frühestens mit dem 01.02.2025 (ggf. abweichende Startzeiten ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los). Der Vertrag endet spätestens am 31.01.2027 (evtl. Ausnahmen ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los), unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses. title: Anskaffelse av konsulentbistand til design av integrasjonsløsning
description: De viktigste punktene DFØ ønsker å oppnå på lang sikt er: - Sammenhengende tjenester og best mulig kundeopplevelse - Etablere et standardisert integrasjonslag som sikrer sømløs informasjonsflyt mellom kundenes fagsystemer og DFØs regnskapsløsning - Etablere en robust og skalerbar arkitektur som forenkler fremtidig forvaltning og vedlikehold av integrasjonsløsningene Målet med integrasjonslaget er å sikre en standardisert, sikker og skalerbar informasjonsflyt. Vi skal nå i gang med en dedikert designfase for å legge de arkitektoniske og tekniske rammene før selve utviklingen og implementeringen starter. Til å bidra inn i dette arbeidet søker vi erfarne konsulenter med spisskompetanse innen integrasjonsarkitektur. Oppgavene organiseres og prioriteres fortløpende innenfor utviklingsløpet. Arbeidet koordineres med DFØs utviklingsmiljø og følger etablerte arbeidsprosesser (herunder sprintbasert metodikk).

description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Cyprus will launch the solicitation on the SAM (System for Award Management) Database https://www.sam.gov website when it is available. The Embassy of the United States in Nicosia will accepts quotations for the maintenance of the HVAC & BMS system . These requirements may change depending on funding availability in fourth coming periods. All responsible sources may submit an offer, which shall be considered. The Government is planning a pre-proposal conference and the date for this conference will be in the solicitation. All contractors must be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) database https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting an offer pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-7. Failure to be registered at time of proposal submission may deem the offeror�s proposal to be considered non-responsible and no further consideration will be given. Therefore, prospective offerors are encouraged to register prior to the submittal of quotations/proposals. Please mail your offer to the contracting office listed in this notice and electronically to NicosiaContracting@state.gov prior to the response date and time. Please ensure your email with your offer does not exceed 15MB, if it does then you might have to send more than one email.

Die Auftraggeberin behält sich vor, das Open-House-Verfahren vorzeitig zu beenden, insbesondere im Falle des Abschlusses exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen; in diesem Fall enden die bereits geschlossenen Rabattvereinbarungen nach Maßgabe der vertraglichen Bestimmungen. title: YRBM-25 Dry-Docking Selected Restricted Availability (DSRA) and Vessel Transportation
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS NOTICE IS ISSUED FOR MARKET RESEARCH AND ACQUISITION PLANNING PURPOSES AND DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION, REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, REQUEST FOR QUOTATION OR COMMITTMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT TO AWARD A CONTRACT. 1. PURPOSE NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Yokosuka (FLCY), Site Marianas, is conducting market research to identify qualified and capable sources with the facilities, technical expertise, resources and transportation capability necessary to perform a comprehensive Dry-Docking Selected Restricted Availability (DSRA) for YRBM-25, a non-self-propelled Repair, Berthing and Messing Barge currently located in Apra Harbor Guam. 2. GENERAL SCOPE OF REQUIREMENT The anticipated DSRA is expected to have an approximate duration of six (6) to eight (8) months. The contractor will be responsible for providing necessary management, planning, supervision, labor, engineering, facilities, dry-docking capability, equipment, materials, transportation, quality control and other resources required to accomplish the availability. The anticipated work includes, but is not limited to: Dry-docking and undocking of YrBM-25; Extensive underwater hull inspection, maintenance, repair and preservation; Identification and repair of structural deficiencies discovered during the availability; Significant structural steel repairs and renewals; inspection, repair and preservation of internal voids and tanks; Inspection, repair, renewals and preservation of associated piping and systems; Surface preparation and preservation necessary to support structural repairs and renewal; Inspection and testing associated with completed repairs; Performance of related systems work necessary to support structural and preservations efforts; Management and accomplishment of emergent or growth work identified during the availability; and Other maintenance and repair work necessary to accomplish the DSRA requirements. The final scope of work, work-item requirements, specifications, inspection requirements and acceptance criteria will be established in any resulting solicitation. 3. VESSEL TRANSPORTATION YRBM-25 is a non-self-propelled vessel. Accordingly, the contemplated requirement includes responsibility for the planning, coordination, management and execution of vessel transportation. The contractor will be responsible for transporting YRBM-25 from its homeport in Apra harbor, Guam, to the contractor�s proposed dry-docking and repair facility. Following completion and Government acceptance of the DSRA, the contractor will also be responsible for transporting YRBM-25 from the contractor�s facility to a Government-designated port in the Pacific located within a 1,500 nautical mile radius of Apra Harbor Guam. Interested sources should identify their proposed method of transportation, such as ocean tow, heavy-lift or another technically viable method, and describe, in detail, their capability to successfully plan, coordinate and execute the transportation. 4. INFORMATION REQUESTED Interested sources should submit information for the Government to assess their ability to successfully accomplish the complete requirement, including transportation, dry-docking, repair, preservation, structural work and return transportation. At a minimum, responses should address: Company name, physical address, UEI, CAGE Code and primary point of contact. Business size and applicable socio-economic status under the anticipated NAICS code. Proposed repair facility, including Facility name and location; Approximate nautical-mile distance from Apra Harbor, Guam; Dry-dock type and capacity; Maximum vessel dimensions and displacement that can be accommodated; Pier and berthing capabilities; Industrial services and utilities; and Other facility capabilities relevant to accomplishing the anticipated DSRA. Relevant experience successfully accomplishing comparable dry-docking availabilities, particularly those involving: Non-self-propelled vessels or barges; Extensive underwater hull preservation; Significant structural steel repair and renewal; Tank and void preservation; Associated piping and systems work; and Other facility capabilities relevant to accomplishing the anticipated DSRA. Transportation capability, including: Proposed method for transporting YRBM-25 from Apra harbor to the proposed facility Whether transportation would be self-performed, subcontracted, or accomplished through a teaming arrangement; Experience transporting comparable non-self-propelled vessels; Anticipated transportation lead time; and Significant permitting, regulatory, customs, international or logistical considerations associated with the proposed transportation approach The respondent�s ability to support an anticipated six- to eight-month DSRA, including facility availability and any anticipated scheduling or capacity constraints. Capability to manage and execute growth and emergent work that may be identified after dry-docking, inspection, opening of tanks or voids, or commencement of structural work. Identification of any Government-furnished information, property, services or other support the respondent believes would be necessary to successfully accomplish the requirement. Any significant technical, schedule, transportation, regulatory or acquisition risks the Government should consider in developing the requirement. Recommendations regarding the contemplated acquisition approach or requirement that could enhance competition, reduce schedule or performance risk or improve successful execution. 5. MARKET RESEARCH The Government is especially seeking information regarding the number and capability of sources that possess or can obtain through appropriate teaming or subcontracting arrangements, the combination of: Suitable docking facilities; (2) ship-repair capability necessary to accomplish a DSRA of this magnitude; (3) significant structural steel and preservation capability; and (4) the ability to successfully transport YRBM-25 from Guam to the proposed facility and return the vessel following completion of the availability. Responses that merely state that the respondent is capable of performing the requirement without providing sufficient information regarding he proposed facility, relevant experience and transportation WILL NOT provide sufficient information for the Government to assess capability. 6. RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS: Interested parties shall submit responses electronically to the POCs listed within this sources sought notice not later than 31 January 2027 at 1200 ChST. Responses should not exceed 20 pages, excluding supporting facility information or standard company literature. The subject should state: �Sources Sought Response � YRBM-25 DSRA and Transportation� The Government may contact respondents for clarification or additional information as part of its market research. 7. DISCLAIMER This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research and acquisition planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation or commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or make an award. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting responses for costs incurred in preparing or submitting response to this notice. Information received may be used in developing the Government�s acquisition strategy, requirements, specifications, independent Government cost estimate and any future solicitation. Participation in this market research is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for participation in any future acquisition.

Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 15 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления. Първият етап е приключил. Втори етап - събиране на оферти по конкретни покани. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления, подадени в посоченият по-горе срок. По всяко време заинтересовани лица могат да подават заявления за допускане/включване в ДСП. Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите предложения в срок до 15 работни дни от постъпването им. Възложителят ще издава решение за допускане на кандидатите в ДСП. ДСП ще функционира за срок до 31.01.2027г. вкл., а именно в този срок възложителят може да отправя покани до допуснатите кандидати за събиране на оферти за доставка на конкретни артикули, съгласно Техническа спецификация, приложена към съответната покана.

The updated list includes the Questions and Answers previously published. * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * NOTICE OF INVITATION TO QUALIFY UPDATE #1 2026-10-16 This update is to: • Extend the closing date • Publish a new version of the Invitation to Qualify (ITQ) document. All changes are flagged in the left margin of the modified document. The document is available under the "Bidding Details" tab • Notify interested vendors that the slideshow used during the webinar held on October 8, 2026 is available under the "Bidding Details" tab • Notify interested vendors that a list of Questions and Answers received during the webinar and by email is available under the "Bidding Details" tab. * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * NATIONAL SECURITY EXCEPTION In respect of all phases of the solicitation, SSC has invoked the National Security Exception (NSE). As such, this invocation exempts all phases of the procurement processes for sovereign cloud services from the application of all of Canada’s trade agreements, including the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (Article III(1)) and the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Article 801). 1. INTRODUCTION The Government of Canada (GC) is advancing its digital infrastructure and hosting capabilities to meet evolving operational requirements and to deliver services to Canadians that are secure, reliable, and user-centric. Building on findings and industry feedback obtained through prior engagement activities, Shared Services Canada (SSC) is establishing a structured Sovereign Cloud Qualification Process as an initial step to support future procurements. The Sovereign Cloud Qualification process is intended to: • Establish a standing entry point for Canadian-owned and -controlled businesses seeking to qualify to participate in sovereign cloud procurements • Enable Canada to collect information on available and emerging offerings to support market awareness and procurement planning • Provide a consistent, transparent, and accessible mechanism for industry engagement • This Notice of Planned Procurement does not constitute a commitment by Canada to issue any solicitation or to procure any services. 2. PROCESS OVERVIEW The Sovereign Cloud Qualification Process is supported by an Invitation to Qualify (ITQ). The ITQ defines the requirements for qualification, including: • Eligibility conditions • Submission requirements • Supporting documentation • Process instructions The qualification process serves as the entry point and a mandatory step for vendors to participate in current and future sovereign cloud procurement processes. Vendors that participate in the qualification process and meet the eligibility conditions defined in the ITQ will be considered as Qualified Respondents (QR) for participation in future sovereign cloud procurement opportunities. This qualification process is not a competitive procurement process and will not result in a contract award. It is intended solely to establish a list of qualified vendors for participation in future procurement activities. 3. ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS Eligibility conditions details are defined in the ITQ (available in tab “Bidding Details” above). At a minimum, eligibility conditions include: • Confirmation of Respondent’s Canadian ownership and control, including parent companies. • Submission of a Value Proposition describing the respondent’s sovereign cloud offerings. 4. OBJECTIVE AND SCOPE 4.1 Objective The objective of the Sovereign Cloud Services procurement stream is to strengthen Canada’s cloud posture by enabling and supporting solutions that advance Canadian control over data and services, and protection from foreign legal or extraterritorial authority. The sovereign cloud procurement stream is intended to complement, and not replace, existing cloud procurement approaches. 4.2 Scope (Indicative Only) The service categories described below are indicative only and provided to inform respondents of the types of capabilities Canada may consider procuring in the future. Additional requirements, eligibility conditions, certifications, or evaluation criteria will be defined in future procurement stages once the procurement process is confirmed The scope of the Sovereign Cloud Services procurement stream may include, but is not limited to: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): This category may include sovereign fundamental computing resources such as processing, storage, and networking. These services allow departments to deploy and run their own software, including operating systems and applications. While the cloud provider manages the underlying infrastructure, Canada retains control over operating systems, storage, deployed applications, and certain network configuration. Platform as a Service (PaaS): This category may include sovereign cloud services that allow departments to deploy and run applications built using programming languages, libraries, services, and tools supported by the provider. The provider manages the underlying infrastructure, including networks, servers, operating systems, and storage, while Canada retains control over the applications it deploys and the configuration of the application hosting environment. AI enabling services: This category may include sovereign services that support the development, deployment, or operation of artificial intelligence solutions, such as machine learning platforms, model hosting, data processing environments, and AI infrastructure. Managed Service Providers of Classified Cloud Solutions: This category may include managed services for classified cloud solutions. Vendors intending to operate as infrastructure providers will be required to provide certification from a recognized classified cloud solution provider in the Five Eyes confirming their authorization and agreement to deliver classified cloud services and associated managed solutions. Recognizing that many classified and unclassified cloud solutions are operated or owned by foreign providers, Canada may also consider managed service providers that have unique access to such cloud service solutions, even where those solutions are owned by foreign entities. In such cases, the managed service provider will need to demonstrate full control over the technology and the delivery of services. Other cloud or cloud enabling capabilities that support sovereign digital service delivery. This category may include other sovereign cloud or cloud-enabling capabilities not otherwise described in the indicative scopes provided above. 5. SUBMISSION PROCEDURES To participate in the Sovereign Cloud Qualification process, respondents must complete and submit the designated submission form in accordance with the requirements set out in the ITQ. 6. title: Facility Readiness and Maintenance Execution (FRAME) Request for Proposal (RFP) - DRAFT
description: This Special Notice provides interested parties with information regarding the availability of the draft Request for Proposal (dRFP), review requirements, the tentative acquisition schedule, and the upcoming Industry Day and Site Visit. This notice is for planning purposes only and does not constitute an invitation for bids, request for proposals, or quotes, nor does it indicate that the Government will contract for the items described herein. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with submitting feedback or attending the events outlined in this notice. The 30th Contracting Squadron (30 CONS/PKD) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB), CA, is requesting industry feedback on the dRFP for the Facility Readiness and Maintenance Execution (FRAME) contract. FRAME is the follow-on acquisition to the current Launch Operations Support Contract (LOSC) (Contract #FA4610-23-D-0001, currently performed by Call Henry, Inc.). FRAME follow-on acquisition is 100% Small Business Set-Aside. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this effort is 561210 Facilities Support Services (small business size standard is $47M). Description of Services, Background, and Objective: FRAME is a non-personal services contract that provides maintenance, repair, modification, and modernization for?over 130?facilities, property, and equipment (P&E)?supporting?the nation�s space mission, defense, and test activities at VSFB and its associated geographically-separated locations. The scope of work involves facility infrastructure and systems (including water and gas mains, roads, generators, power distribution, HVAC, waste systems, and roofing) alongside the execution of distinct sustainment projects and?standby support for urgent repairs during select?launch operations to ensure maximum operational readiness. Additionally, the contract encompasses the inspection,?testing,?and certification of all Space Launch Delta 30 cranes and elevators. A key change under this follow-on acquisition is that the South Vandenberg Power Plant (SVPP) is no longer a requirement and will not be carried over from the legacy LOSC to the new FRAME contract. The primary objective of the FRAME contract is to ensure Real Property Installed Equipment (RPIE) and facilities are maintained and operationally ready for a variety of ballistic missile, space, guided weapon, and aircraft test and evaluation missions in support of Space Launch Delta 30 (SLD 30), 30th Civil Engineer Squadron (30 CES), 4th Launch Squadron (4 LS), 2nd Range Operations Squadron (2 ROPS), Missile Defense Agency (MDA), U. S. Space Forces - Space (S4S), 18th Space Defense Squadron (18 SDS), Sentinel, 30th Operations Support Squadron (30 OSS), 2nd Space Launch Squadron (2 SLS), the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), and various other Range Users. Mission Essential Services: The FRAME contract contains some mission-essential requirements which require continued support during peacetime, national emergency, and/or wartime scenarios. Tentative Acquisition Schedule: dRFP Release: 8 Sep 26 Final RFP Issuance: Jan 27 Proposals Due: Mar 27 Anticipated Award: 18 Dec 27 Performance Start:?1 Apr 28 4. Industry Day and Site Visit Event Details Interested businesses are invited to register for the upcoming two-day event. Representatives will have the opportunity to attend a briefing detailing the contract structure, tour key range facilities, and participate in one-on-one sessions with the Government program team. Dates: September 22, 2026 (General Briefing & Tour) � September 23, 2026 (One-on-One Sessions) Location: Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB), CA Maximum Attendees: Limited to two (2) representatives per prospective company due to base logistical constraints. Registration and RSVP Deadlines: Attendee RSVP & Security Vetting Submission: No later than Friday, September 11, 2026, at 16:30 Pacific Time. Provide your full name and company. Late requests may not be processed. One-on-One Meeting Request: Companies interested in booking a one-on-one session with the program office must explicitly request it via email by Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 16:30 Pacific Time. Slots are limited and will be scheduled on a first-come, first-served basis. Maps and a tentative agenda are attached to this announcement to assist registered attendees with navigation and scheduling. Base Access & Entry Requirements: All site visit attendees must report to the Vandenberg Visitor Control Center (VCC), located at 6 California Blvd (Santa Maria Gate) prior to entry (VCC hours: 0600-1800). Arrive Early: Attendees are strongly encouraged to arrive early to the Visitor Control Center to allow sufficient time for base entry processing and to avoid delays getting to the briefing. Identification for Non-CAC Holders: Attendees who do not possess a Common Access Card (CAC) must present a REAL ID-compliant credential or a valid U.S. Passport. If an attendee does not have a REAL ID or a Passport, they must bring and present a standard state-issued Driver's License or ID card, a Birth Certificate, and a physical Social Security Card to obtain a base visitor pass. Foreign Nationals will not be able to participate due to the time necessary to vet access. 5. Important Site Visit Disclaimers & Rules of Conduct: Change of Solicitation Terms: Please understand that nothing said during the Industry Day briefings, site tours, or one-on-one sessions by any Government representative changes the terms, conditions, specifications, or requirements of the solicitation. If a change to the solicitation is determined to be necessary based on what is discussed or observed, it will be formally issued as a written amendment via email. Photography and Video Restrictions: No photography or video recording is permitted on this installation at any time, unless specific, designated areas are explicitly pointed out and authorized by the hosting Facility Manager. 6. Submission of Questions & Comments (CRM) The Government is actively seeking industry feedback on the Draft PWS and planned acquisition strategy to ensure clear, high-performing requirements. To submit questions or comments concerning the acquisition and dRFP, prospective offerors must use the official Comment Resolution Matrix (CRM) Excel spreadsheet (which will be posted with the Draft RFP documents). Completed CRM spreadsheets must be returned to the Points of Contact listed below. The deadline for submitting dRFP and Industry Day comments is September 29, 2026, by 16:30 Pacific Time. 7. Primary Points of Contact For all RSVP submissions, one-on-one requests, CRM question submittals or administrative questions, please send correspondence via email to BOTH of the following representatives: Primary POC (Contracting Officer): Katherine Williams, 30 CONS/PKD Email: katherine.williams.9@spaceforce.mil Secondary POC (Contract Specialist): Sabrina Swain, 30 CONS/PKD Email: sabrina.swain.1@spaceforce.mil 9/8/2026: This office is updating this draft RFP to update and add additional attachments. 9/29/2026: This office is updating the tentative acquisition schedule and extending the date of this draft RFP. 10/8/2026: This office is adding the following attachments to this draft RFP: FRAME Industry Day Brief, FRAME Industry Day CRM 20261008, and FRAME RFP_GFP List_07Oct2026.

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss nicht-exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V (Open-House-Modell)
description: Gegenstand dieser Veröffentlichung ist der Abschluss von Vereinbarungen nach § 130 a Abs. 8 SGB V zu Fertigarzneimitteln mit verschiedenen Wirkstoffen bzw. Wirkstoffkombinationen im Rahmen eines sogenannten „Open-House-Modells“. Der Beitritt bzw. der Vertragsabschluss kann jederzeit und zu den gleichen Bedingungen erfolgen. title: Italy – Repair and maintenance services of mechanical building installations – Procedura aperta sopra soglia comunitaria, ai sensi dell'art. 71 del d.lgs. n. 36/2023, articolata in n. 2 lotti, per l'affidamento del Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili delle Sedi Regionali Rai dell'Umbria e dell'Abruzzo
description: Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili delle Sedi Regionali Rai dell’Umbria e dell’Abruzzo (lotto n. 1 Umbria - lotto n. 2 Abruzzo), per una durata di 36 mesi con opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi (durata massima 60 mesi). La prestazione richiesta riguarda l’esercizio e la manutenzione ordinaria e a richiesta degli impianti elettrici, di climatizzazione, edili, elevatori, antincendio e di rivelazione incendi, di antintrusione e controllo accessi, di televisione a circuito chiuso (TVCC) e degli impianti TV, nonché la gestione e manutenzione delle aree verdi. Il servizio oggetto dell’affidamento prevede le seguenti prestazioni: a) manutenzione ordinaria (a canone): esercizio degli impianti elettrici e HVAC, manutenzione ordinaria degli impianti, dei componenti edilizi e delle aree verdi, presenza continuativa per esercizio e manutenzione degli impianti; b) manutenzione straordinaria (su richiesta Rai) afferente alle suddette attività; come descritto all’interno del Progetto di servizi. Non sono previsti limiti alla partecipazione ai lotti né all’aggiudicazione di più lotti al medesimo operatore economico. Informazioni e chiarimenti possono essere richiesti entro e non oltre il 21/01/2027 utilizzando l’area “Comunicazioni riservate al Concorrente”, presente nell’area di dettaglio della procedura. Le risposte alle richieste di chiarimenti sono fornite mediante pubblicazione delle richieste in forma anonima e delle relative risposte sulla Piattaforma nell’area “Comunicazioni della Stazione Appaltante”. È previsto il sopralluogo obbligatorio, da svolgersi dall’11/01/2027 al 15/01/2027 secondo termini e modalità previsti nel Disciplinare di gara. Saranno previste le seguenti fattispecie di modifica contrattuale, in tutti i lotti: - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 10 del Codice sarà prevista un’opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi; pertanto, in caso di esercizio di detta opzione, la durata complessiva massima del contratto sarà pari a 60 mesi; in tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - in casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata del contratto base o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione, ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente. In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, qualora l’importo contrattuale (del contratto “base” o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione) non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale, di estendere la durata del relativo contratto per il tempo necessario a poter utilizzare l’intero importo contrattuale; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di inserire od escludere dal contratto, in tutto o in parte (a titolo esemplificativo, per un immobile, per parte dell’immobile e/o per parte degli impianti e/o dei servizi), anche per limitati periodi, insediamenti che siano acquisiti e/o ceduti ovvero entrino o escano dalla disponibilità giuridica della Stazione appaltante ovvero siano oggetto di consistenti interventi di ristrutturazione, senza diritto da parte dell’Aggiudicatario ad alcuna indennità o altra forma di riconoscimento economico, fermo restando il versamento dei corrispettivi per le prestazioni regolarmente eseguite sino alla data della modifica. A riguardo, l’Aggiudicatario prende atto ed accetta che il Servizio dovrà essere eseguito con continuità anche in caso di eventuali variazioni delle consistenze e della dislocazione delle sedi e degli immobili oggetto di manutenzione. La valutazione economica di tali modifiche/varianti avverrà facendo riferimento ai corrispettivi contrattuali. In particolare, il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza delle parti escluse/incluse e/o del periodo di esclusione dalla manutenzione, sulla base delle informazioni contenute nel Progetto di Servizi e relativi allegati; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di apportare modifiche al contratto durante il periodo di efficacia ove si verifichino scostamenti di tipo tecnologico nelle consistenze individuate all’interno della documentazione di gara, ed in tale evenienza il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza degli scostamenti verificatisi; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. d) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, in corso di esecuzione, di sostituire l’aggiudicatario iniziale con un nuovo contraente nei seguenti casi: a) risoluzione del contratto per eccessiva onerosità sopravvenuta della prestazione ai sensi del Codice civile; b) risoluzione del contratto per impossibilità sopravvenuta ai sensi del Codice civile. In tali circostanze, la sostituzione potrà interessare solo soggetti che hanno partecipato alla presente procedura alle condizioni proposte dall’operatore economico interpellato secondo le modalità di cui all’art. 124 del Codice. - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 9 del Codice, in caso di variazione in aumento o in diminuzione delle prestazioni fino a concorrenza del quinto dell’importo del contratto, Rai S.p.A. potrà imporre all’appaltatore l’esecuzione alle stesse condizioni previste nel contratto originario.

title: Romania – Programming services of application software – Servicii soluție informatică integrată în cadrul Proiectului ”Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping"
description: Achizitia serviciilor de dezvoltare si implementare a Platformei de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agentia Nationala Anti-Doping, precum si a produselor hardware, a licentelor software si a solutiilor de securitate cibernetica necesare functionarii acesteia, in cadrul proiectului cod SMIS 342867. Prin prestarea serviciilor solicitate, autoritatea contractanta urmareste digitalizarea serviciilor publice furnizate de ANAD la un grad de sofisticare 4, care sa asigure o interactiune digitala avansata intre ANAD si beneficiarii serviciilor publice furnizate de aceasta. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor solicitarilor de clarificare/informatiilor suplimentare in a 11-a zi inainte de termenul limita stabilit pentru depunerea ofertelor. Numarul de zile pana la care se pot solicita clarificari inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor: 20 zile. ANAD dorește să achiziționeze servicii soluție informatică integrată (pachet complet pentru implementarea soluției informatice de digitalizare a serviciilor publice ANAD , hardware, licente, servicii dezvoltare, Securitate cibernetică, instruire).Achiziția este planificată în cadrul proiectului „Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping”, Cod SMIS 342867, finanțat prin Programul Creștere Inteligentă, Digitalizare și Instrumente Financiare 2021–2027 (PoCIDIF). În contextul accelerării transformării digitale la nivel european și național, precum și al creșterii cerințelor de eficiență operațională, ANAD inițiază un proiect amplu de digitalizare a serviciilor publice oferite, intitulat „Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping”. Necesitatea proiectului este determinată de limitele infrastructurii informatice actuale și de absența unui cadru digital integrat pentru interacțiunea cu beneficiarii serviciilor anti-doping. Prin realizarea acestui proiect, ANAD își propune să devină un model de bune practici în administrarea publică, oferind servicii eficiente și moderne care să răspundă nevoilor actuale și viitoare ale funcționarilor publici și cetățenilor. title: Sources Sought - Hawaii-Wide Forklift Lease BPA
description: Regional Contracting Office Hawaii (RCO-HI) is conducting market research to identify capable commercial sources that can provide rental or dry lease Material Handling Equipment (MHE), including forklifts and container-handling equipment, in support of Government requirements throughout the Hawaiian Islands. This Sources Sought Notice is issued for market-research and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation, request for quotation, request for proposal, commitment, or obligation by the Government. The Government does not intend to award a contract or Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) as a result of responses to this notice, nor will the Government reimburse any costs associated with preparing a response.RCO-HI anticipates a potential requirement to establish multiple BPAs with qualified vendors to provide MHE rental/dry lease support. Requirements may arise with limited advance notice and may require equipment delivery, pickup, maintenance, repair, replacement equipment, and field-service support. The anticipated areas of performance include Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, and Kauai. Interested vendors may respond if they are capable of supporting one or more of these islands; vendors are not required to demonstrate capability across all locations.The Government is seeking information regarding the commercial availability of approximately 5,000-pound capacity forklifts; approximately 6,000-pound capacity narrow-aisle or warehouse-configured forklifts; approximately 6,000-pound capacity standard industrial forklifts; approximately 10,000-pound capacity industrial, rough-terrain, or telehandler-type forklifts; approximately 30,000-pound capacity heavy-lift forklifts; and Rough Terrain Container Handlers (RTCHs) or commercially comparable container-handling equipment. Equipment may be required for warehouse, installation, field, port, airfield, cargo-handling, and mobilization support activities. For each type of equipment offered, vendors should identify the manufacturer, model, model year, rated lift capacity, lift height, mast configuration, fork length, overall dimensions, operating weight, tire type, fuel or power type, available attachments, and any significant operating limitations. Vendors should also identify whether equipment is physically located on the island where it would be provided, available for transfer from another Hawaiian island, or would require shipment from outside Hawaii.The Government is particularly interested in understanding each vendor???s fleet availability and surge capacity. Interested vendors should identify the number of units in their total fleet for each equipment category, the number of units physically located on Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, and Kauai, and the number of units normally available for short-notice rental. Vendors should state the maximum quantity of each equipment type that they could provide simultaneously for a single Government requirement and should distinguish between equipment available within seven days and equipment available within 30 days. Vendors should also explain whether equipment may be reserved, committed, or otherwise prioritized under a BPA and identify any associated reservation fees, minimum-use periods, cancellation terms, or other commercial conditions.Interested vendors should describe their standard rental or dry lease terms, including the rental periods available and any minimum rental duration. Responses should explain which services are included in quoted rental rates and which services are separately priced. Vendors should describe their preventive-maintenance program, corrective-maintenance procedures, normal and emergency service response times, after-hours and weekend support, and process for providing replacement equipment when a unit becomes non-mission capable. Vendors should also identify any Government responsibilities associated with the rental, including operator qualifications, fuel, cleaning, equipment staging, access coordination, wash-rack use, damage liability, or return-condition requirements.Vendors should describe their delivery, pickup, transportation, and inter-island movement capabilities. Responses should identify normal delivery timelines and emergency delivery timelines after receipt of an order or BPA call, including the vendor???s ability to support 24-hour, 48-hour, 72-hour, five-day, and seven-day response requirements. Vendors should state whether they possess or can arrange heavy-haul transportation suitable for 30,000-pound forklifts, RTCHs, and other oversized or overweight MHE. Vendors should also identify whether they can move equipment between Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, and Kauai; the anticipated transportation method; estimated transit time; and associated costs or constraints.The Government is also seeking information on vendor ability to deliver and service equipment at authorized commercial port facilities, airfields, Hawaii Department of Transportation facilities, military installations, and other controlled-access locations. Vendors should provide a general description of their current ability to access and service such locations, including any anticipated requirements for installation access, vehicle registration, personnel credentialing, safety documentation, insurance, escorts, delivery coordination, or lead time. Vendors should not submit sensitive credentials, security plans, or personally identifiable information in response to this notice.To assist the Government in developing an acquisition strategy and independent Government cost estimate, vendors should provide nonbinding budgetary pricing for each equipment category offered. Pricing information should include daily, weekly, and monthly rental rates; delivery and pickup charges; mobilization and demobilization charges; inter-island transportation charges; attachment costs; excess-hour charges; environmental or administrative fees; damage-waiver costs; emergency, after-hours, weekend, or holiday charges; and any other recurring or nonrecurring costs. Vendors should identify discounts available for multiple units, extended rental periods, recurring BPA calls, advance reservations, multiple-island support, or other volume-based arrangements. Vendors should also identify the anticipated duration for which proposed pricing could remain valid and describe any expected escalation factors.Interested vendors should provide company name, business address, website, primary point of contact, telephone number, email address, Unique Entity ID, CAGE code if applicable, and business size and socioeconomic status under the applicable North American Industry Classification System code. Vendors should identify whether they are the equipment owner, an authorized dealer, a broker, or a prime contractor using subcontracted equipment or maintenance support. If subcontractors, affiliates, or third-party equipment owners would be used, the vendor should identify their role and explain the respondent???s ability to control equipment availability, delivery, maintenance, and response times.The email subject line should state: ???Sources Sought Response ??? MHE Rental/Dry Lease Support ??? Hawaiian Islands ??? [Company Name].??? Responses should clearly identify the Hawaiian island or islands that the vendor can support and the types and quantities of equipment available at each location.This notice is for planning and market-research purposes only. It does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation, establish a BPA, award a contract, or pay for information received in response to this notice. The Government may use information received to refine the scope, determine the appropriate acquisition strategy, assess small-business capability, establish potential geographic groupings or line items, and develop future solicitation requirements.

description: Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili delle Sedi Regionali Rai dell’Umbria e dell’Abruzzo (lotto n. 1 Umbria - lotto n. 2 Abruzzo), per una durata di 36 mesi con opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi (durata massima 60 mesi). La prestazione richiesta riguarda l’esercizio e la manutenzione ordinaria e a richiesta degli impianti elettrici, di climatizzazione, edili, elevatori, antincendio e di rivelazione incendi, di antintrusione e controllo accessi, di televisione a circuito chiuso (TVCC) e degli impianti TV, nonché la gestione e manutenzione delle aree verdi. Il servizio oggetto dell’affidamento prevede le seguenti prestazioni: a) manutenzione ordinaria (a canone): esercizio degli impianti elettrici e HVAC, manutenzione ordinaria degli impianti, dei componenti edilizi e delle aree verdi, presenza continuativa per esercizio e manutenzione degli impianti; b) manutenzione straordinaria (su richiesta Rai) afferente alle suddette attività; come descritto all’interno del Progetto di servizi. Non sono previsti limiti alla partecipazione ai lotti né all’aggiudicazione di più lotti al medesimo operatore economico. Informazioni e chiarimenti possono essere richiesti entro e non oltre il 21/01/2027 utilizzando l’area “Comunicazioni riservate al Concorrente”, presente nell’area di dettaglio della procedura. Le risposte alle richieste di chiarimenti sono fornite mediante pubblicazione delle richieste in forma anonima e delle relative risposte sulla Piattaforma nell’area “Comunicazioni della Stazione Appaltante”. È previsto il sopralluogo obbligatorio, da svolgersi dall’11/01/2027 al 15/01/2027 secondo termini e modalità previsti nel Disciplinare di gara. Saranno previste le seguenti fattispecie di modifica contrattuale, in tutti i lotti: - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 10 del Codice sarà prevista un’opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi; pertanto, in caso di esercizio di detta opzione, la durata complessiva massima del contratto sarà pari a 60 mesi; in tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - in casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata del contratto base o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione, ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente. In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, qualora l’importo contrattuale (del contratto “base” o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione) non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale, di estendere la durata del relativo contratto per il tempo necessario a poter utilizzare l’intero importo contrattuale; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di inserire od escludere dal contratto, in tutto o in parte (a titolo esemplificativo, per un immobile, per parte dell’immobile e/o per parte degli impianti e/o dei servizi), anche per limitati periodi, insediamenti che siano acquisiti e/o ceduti ovvero entrino o escano dalla disponibilità giuridica della Stazione appaltante ovvero siano oggetto di consistenti interventi di ristrutturazione, senza diritto da parte dell’Aggiudicatario ad alcuna indennità o altra forma di riconoscimento economico, fermo restando il versamento dei corrispettivi per le prestazioni regolarmente eseguite sino alla data della modifica. A riguardo, l’Aggiudicatario prende atto ed accetta che il Servizio dovrà essere eseguito con continuità anche in caso di eventuali variazioni delle consistenze e della dislocazione delle sedi e degli immobili oggetto di manutenzione. La valutazione economica di tali modifiche/varianti avverrà facendo riferimento ai corrispettivi contrattuali. In particolare, il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza delle parti escluse/incluse e/o del periodo di esclusione dalla manutenzione, sulla base delle informazioni contenute nel Progetto di Servizi e relativi allegati; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di apportare modifiche al contratto durante il periodo di efficacia ove si verifichino scostamenti di tipo tecnologico nelle consistenze individuate all’interno della documentazione di gara, ed in tale evenienza il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza degli scostamenti verificatisi; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. d) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, in corso di esecuzione, di sostituire l’aggiudicatario iniziale con un nuovo contraente nei seguenti casi: a) risoluzione del contratto per eccessiva onerosità sopravvenuta della prestazione ai sensi del Codice civile; b) risoluzione del contratto per impossibilità sopravvenuta ai sensi del Codice civile. In tali circostanze, la sostituzione potrà interessare solo soggetti che hanno partecipato alla presente procedura alle condizioni proposte dall’operatore economico interpellato secondo le modalità di cui all’art. 124 del Codice. - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 9 del Codice, in caso di variazione in aumento o in diminuzione delle prestazioni fino a concorrenza del quinto dell’importo del contratto, Rai S.p.A. potrà imporre all’appaltatore l’esecuzione alle stesse condizioni previste nel contratto originario.

title: IFK-26-01-NF Utbygging av bredbåndsinfrastruktur i Nord-Fron kommune
description: Formål Nord-Fron kommune har til hensikt å inngå avtale om utbygging av høykapasitetsbredbåndsinfrastruktur, gjennom å gi støtte til utbyggere. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å dekke oppdragsgivers behov for kostnadseffektivt høyhastighetsbredbånd for de angitte adresser i konkurransegrunnlaget og å sikre at flest mulig innbyggere og næringsdrivende skal få mulighet til å knytte seg til høyhastighetsbredbånd, der slike løsninger i dag ikke er tilgjengelige. Leverandøren skal bruke sin fagkunnskap og kompetanse for å bidra til at kontraktens formål blir ivaretatt. Omfang Omfanget av anskaffelsen skal dekke høyhastighetsbredbånd til de adresser som er oppgitt som husstander i vedlagt adressegrunnlag, i henhold til vedlagte kravspesifikasjon Oppdragsgiver har til hensikt å bygge bredbåndsinfrastruktur i området angitt i adresselisten og i fylkeskommunens kartløsning. Kart over området ligger i Innlandet fylkeskommunes kartverk. Følg linken nedenfor: https://geocortex3.innlandsgis.no/ifk/bredband/bredbandinnsyn.html Kommunen har bestemt at den enkelte husstanden skal ha en egenandel på kr. 10 000,- Kommunen tillegger utbygger å innhente denne egenandelen fra husstand, ved gjennomføring av salg. Tilbyder kan ved salg velge å dekke hele eller deler av husstandens egenandel, dersom dette er ønskelig. Tilbyder skal derfor ikke legge inn annen tilkoblingsavgift i sitt tilbud. For komplett oversikt over området som er del av anskaffelsen og tekniske krav, henvises det til vedlagte kravspesifikasjon og øvrige dokumenter med oversikt over områdene. Det kreves at 100% av oppgitte adresser dekkes av tilbudet, for å kunne ansees som et komplett tilbud. Dersom enkelte adresser viser seg svært fordyrende å bygge ut, vil dette bli et tema i forhandlinger. Tilbyder bes vise hvilke adresser som eventuelt er svært fordyrende og hva disse adressene koster. Terskel for gjennomføring av kontraktsarbeidene, vil være ved 65% «take-rate» ved salg. Dette skal hensynta eventuelle grossistsalg og ikke bare valgt leverandørs salg. Dette beregnes ut ifra adresselistene som oppdragsgiver har benyttet i konkurransegrunnlaget. For kontrakter som omfatter 10 eller færre husstander, er det ønskelig med dialog mellom oppdragsgiver og leverandør for å vurdere hva som skal til for å kunne gjennomføre utbyggingen dersom «take-rate» er under 65%. Oppdragsgivers adresselister har forrang over kartpolygon for området. Kontraktstype Det skal inngås avtale med én leverandør. title: Nytt fagsystem for Garantikassen for fiskere
description: Garantikassen for fiskere ønsker å få anbud på nytt fagsystem, og viser til vedlagt konkurransegrunnlag. Kort oppsummert ønsker vi følgende: · Et nytt, helhetlig fagsystem som erstatter dagens løsning og støtter Garantikassens tilskudds- og ytelsesordninger. · Trinnvis utvikling i to faser: først funksjonalitet for mannskapsbaserte ordninger, deretter fartøybaserte ordninger, med samlet produksjonssetting og overtakelse etter fase 2. · En fleksibel og fremtidsrettet løsning med modulær arkitektur, konfigurerbare regler og satser, gode integrasjoner og mulighet for å etablere nye ordninger uten omfattende endringer i programkoden. · Høy sikkerhet og kvalitet, inkludert personvern, tilgangsstyring, logging, full historikk og sporbarhet samt robuste rutiner for test, feil- og avvikshåndtering. · Gode og effektive brukerflater for både interne saksbehandlere og eksterne brukere, med støtte for dokumentproduksjon, søknadsbehandling, vedtak, beregning, utbetaling og oppgjør. · En kompetent og samarbeidende leverandør som kan gjennomføre utviklingen smidig og iterativt, sikre dokumentasjon og kompetanseoverføring og bidra aktivt til risikostyring og videreutvikling. · Langsiktig vedlikehold og forvaltning av den samlede løsningen etter overtakelse, regulert gjennom SSA-T for utvikling og etablering og SSA-V for vedlikehold, forvaltning og videreutvikling.

description: Formål Lom kommune har til hensikt å gi tilskudd til etablering av basestasjoner, for å forbedre områder med dårlig mobildekning. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å dekke kommunens behov for utbedring i områder med dårlig mobildekning. Leverandøren skal bruke sin fagkunnskap og kompetanse for å bidra til at kontraktens formål blir ivaretatt. Omfang Omfanget av anskaffelsen skal dekke vedlagte kartutsnitt. Utbygger kan selv finne plassering som passer best. For komplett oversikt over området som er del av anskaffelsen og tekniske krav, henvises det til vedlagte kravspesifikasjon og øvrige dokumenter med oversikt over områdene. Kontraktstype Det skal inngås avtale med én leverandør. Avtale vil være en tilpasset NS 8406 Forenklet norsk bygge- og anleggskontrakt, som tilpasses slik at det tas høyde for at utbygger også blir eier. De spesielle kontraktbestemmelser ligger vedlagt.

OVERVIEW OF THE RESEARCH OPPORTUNITY This publication constitutes a Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) for awards by Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane Division (NSWC Crane) Contracts Department, as well as other federal entities where appropriate, as contemplated in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016, the Department of Defense Grants and Agreements Regulations (DoDGARS) 32 CFR 22.315(a) and the, Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment Other Transaction Guide version 2.0 dated July 2023. The NAICS code for contracts under this announcement is �541715� with a small business size standard of �1,000 employees.� I. DETAILED INFORMATION ABOUT THE FUNDING OPPORTUNITY A. Program Description This announcement seeks revolutionary research ideas, and technology demonstrators that offer potential for advancement and improvement of NSWC Crane�s primary mission areas. ? Funding Opportunity Description NSWC Crane is a field activity of the Naval Sea Systems Command. NSWC Crane supports a wide range of government agencies in the interest of national security. NSWC Crane may publish BAAs and other solicitations in response to specific needs. This BAA is issued to seek innovative solutions and ideas for topics not covered via other means. It is strongly encouraged that potential proposers review existing NSWC Crane solicitations to avoid duplication of effort and to contact the identified points of contact for each BAA topic to discuss specific details of the needs. ? Crane Mission and Technical Capabilities The mission of NSWC Crane is to provide research, development, test and evaluation, acquisition engineering, in-service engineering, and technical support in its assigned technical capabilities for the United States Navy, Department of Defense components and agencies, and other federal agencies and components engaged in national security. NSWC Crane also works to apply component and system-level product and industrial engineering to surface sensors, strategic systems, special warfare devices and electronic warfare systems, as well as to execute other responsibilities as assigned by the Commander, Naval Surface Warfare Center. The focus of NSWC Crane is �Harnessing the Power of Technology for the Warfighter.� Crane specializes in total lifecycle support in three broad focus areas: Expeditionary Warfare, Strategic Missions, and Electronic Warfare, which support ten assigned technical capabilities (TCs) listed below. 1. Electronic Warfare (EW) 2. Infrared and Pyrotechnic Countermeasures 3. Strategic Systems Hardware 4. Expeditionary Warfare and Systems 5. Advanced Electronics 6. Sensors and Surveillance Systems 7. Hypersonic Weapon Systems 8. Power and Energy Systems 9. Electro-optic and Infrared Technologies 10. Force level EW Mission Analysis, Advanced Concepts and Technologies Within each of the TCs, there are multiple thrust areas, which present considerable opportunities for innovative research and solutions to support national security imperatives. There is intentional overlapping space within the listed TC such that a potential technology or research idea may support multiple TCs. Any proposal should list the principal TC as well as any adjunct TCs that should be considered. Proposals that support multiple TCs are strongly desired but not necessary. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Scalable Porous Silica Materials for Separation, Filtration, and Catalysis
description: A patented manufacturing process for producing porous silica materials with interconnected pore networks. Manufacturers use porous silica materials in products ranging from chromatography columns and filters to catalyst supports and insulation. However, producing these materials with consistent internal structures can be expensive and difficult to scale. Los Alamos researchers developed a patented process that converts silicone foam into porous silica while preserving its internal pore network. The approach uses common materials and conventional molding techniques, offering a scalable and potentially lower-cost route to high-performance porous silica materials. Many applications rely on porous materials that contain large internal surface areas and pathways for liquids and gases to flow. Silica is particularly attractive because it is chemically stable, heat resistant, and already widely used in separation, filtration, and catalytic processes. While porous silica is not new, manufacturing large or complex porous silica components can require specialized fabrication methods that are difficult to scale or expensive to implement. Los Alamos researchers addressed this challenge by developing a process that begins with a silicone foam and converts it into porous silica through a controlled heating process. Because the material can be molded before conversion, manufacturers can produce porous silica components in a variety of sizes and shapes while maintaining the internal pore structure needed for many industrial applications. Advantages � Simple manufacturing process using readily available materials � Produces porous silica parts in a wide range of sizes and shapes � Preserves internal pore networks during conversion from silicone to silica � Compatible with existing molding and manufacturing approaches � Suitable for high-temperature applications � Potentially lower production costs than more complex porous silica fabrication methods � Supports applications in separation, filtration, catalysis, and insulation Market Applications � Chemical manufacturing and process industries � Separation and purification technologies � Industrial filtration systems � Energy storage and electrochemical technologies � Advanced catalyst manufacturing � Environmental monitoring and sensing � Advanced materials and specialty ceramics � Aerospace, defense, and thermal management applications Technology Description The patented SWIFT-Si process begins by mixing silicone-based materials, water, and other common ingredients to create a foam. As the mixture cures, the silicone and water naturally separate into interconnected regions, creating a continuous network of pores throughout the material. This pore structure is locked into place as the foam hardens. The foam can be poured into molds and formed into a variety of shapes and sizes before undergoing a controlled heating process. During heating, the silicone is converted into silica, a material commonly used in chromatography media, filtration systems, catalyst supports, and thermal insulation. The process is designed to preserve the original pore network while the material is converted from silicone to silica. A final heat treatment removes any remaining organic material, leaving behind a porous silica part that retains much of the original internal structure. Because the material is shaped before conversion, manufacturers can produce porous silica components using conventional molding techniques rather than more specialized fabrication methods. The result is a manufacturing process designed to simplify production of porous silica materials while preserving the pore structures needed for industrial applications. description: Scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory developed the Spectrometer Purposed for Accelerator Testing and Characterization (SPATC) � a portable, easy-to-use device that allows the safe measurement of the power and energy of electron beams from particle accelerators, helping labs test and fine-tune equipment more efficiently. How it Works: SPATC uses a smart, compact design to deliver high-precision beam diagnostics conveniently. At its core, SPATC employs two precisely controlled aluminum wedges that slide together to vary thickness, allowing engineers to analyze how an electron beam�s energy interacts with the material. As the beam passes through these layers, sensors record how much energy is absorbed versus transmitted, and a graphite block captures the remaining beam for accurate current readings. Controlled remotely via computer, SPATC provides real-time data on beam energy and current�without breaking vacuum or requiring complex setup. Designed for flexibility and speed, it offers industries a reliable, low-cost, and portable solution to ensure accelerator performance meets exacting standards for research, manufacturing, or medical applications. Key Advantages: Portable and Compact: Fits into a single rugged case for easy transport and setup at any facility. Fast, Accurate Measurements: Determines beam energy and current in under an hour, minimizing downtime. Remote Operation: Fully controllable from outside the accelerator vault, improving safety and efficiency. Non-invasive Testing: Performs measurements in open air without breaking the accelerator�s vacuum. Precision Engineering: Stepper motor-driven wedges provide fine control over measurement thickness for high accuracy. Enhanced Safety: Reduces radiation exposure by eliminating the need for manual adjustments near the beam. Market Applications: Medical and Radiation Therapy Facilities: Ensures precise calibration of electron beams used in cancer treatment systems. title: Commissioning Homes for Children Looked After & Care Leavers PDPS - Lot 1 Rd 7
description: The London Borough of Newham has established a Pseudo-Dynamic Purchasing System (PDPS) for the supply of services in respect of children's externally commissioned care, accommodation and support services. This notice is for the re-opening of Lot 1 Round 7. The services include: Lot 1: Provision of Semi-Independent Living Services - already established Lot 2: Provision of Children's Homes regulated by Ofsted - already established Lot 3: Provision of Supported Lodgings Lot 4: Provision of Independent Fostering Agencies (IFA) regulated by Ofsted These services will be available to looked after children, care leavers and young people who are homeless or at risk of homelessness . Potential Suppliers are invited to Tender for one or more of the Lots. This PDPS is open for use to the following (and subject to Section 3 Scope of Agreement of LAC PDPS Agreement Processor): • any Public Body outlined in either Part I or Part II of the Local Authorities (Goods and Services) (Public Bodies) Order 1972. Details of these can be found at http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1972/853/made The Procurement is being procured by the Authority for the benefit of the Authority and the Partner Organisations. The procurement is being conducted in accordance with the Public Contracts Regulations 2015. The procurement is subject to the light-touch regime under Section 7 Social and Other Specific Services. Under Regulation 76 the Council is free to establish a procedure, provided that procedure is sufficient to ensure compliance with the principles of transparency and equal treatment of economic operators (Suppliers). The Authority has created a tender process outlined below, as part of the PDPS applying the award criteria specified in this contract notice. Any interested organisation/consortium with relevant experience may submit a Bid in response to this ITT. The Council is using the one stage procedure for admission onto the PDPS The Light Touch PDPS will be conducted in staged Rounds. Rounds will open and close throughout the lifetime of the PDPS at the Authorities discretion. Following on from this, each Round will be open to new or previously unsuccessful Suppliers to submit their bid. This means that applications can be submitted throughout the duration of the PDPS, but the Council will only process the applications as and when the round is closed. Please note the length of Rounds will vary throughout the lifetime of the PDPS. Further Rounds will be communicated within the tender documents at time of publication. Any changes to the procurement Timetable shall be notified to all Tenderers as soon as practicable.
